title: The Polite Bowling Ball
premise: A bowler needs to clear a lane, but their sentient ball refuses to bump into the pins. After failed pep talks, the ball offers each pin a tiny chair at the side, rolls peacefully to the end, and receives a handmade KINDNESS score instead of a strike.
hook: This ball refuses to be rude.
visible_action: Ball stops before the pins, gestures apologetically, rolls out ten miniature chairs, and escorts the pins sideways.
intended_takeaway_or_theme: Sometimes the goal can be redefined without a collision.
gate: Bowling equipment is personified; the ending intentionally does not follow real scoring rules.

style_application.why: Weight, hesitation and small deformations communicate intention.
style_application.check: Preserve volume, contact and intentional timing.

editorial_pick.original_reason: A polite bowling ball can show intention through timing and trajectory without elaborate dialogue.
editorial_pick.proposed_first_version: Use one ball, a few original characters and a simple stage. Let hesitation and courteous detours carry the comedy.
editorial_pick.gate: Keep the physics visibly fictional where necessary and make the final objective readable.
editorial_pick.note: These are the catalogue's historical editorial recommendations, not current owner-approved selections or guaranteed watchable stories. Reapply the latest comedy/suspense gate.
